card.name: The word not after auxiliary verbs
card.fires_on: The word "not" right after an auxiliary or modal verb (do, did, had, were, are, may) in older, literary or archaic-style prose. Occasionally a similar linking word such as "likewise".

modes.label: not after auxiliary
modes.description: "not" follows do, did, had, were, are or may in historical or biblical prose.
modes.example: Awake! Do<< not>> cast us off for ever!

modes.label: other linking words
modes.description: A rarer linking word like "likewise" or "part" in a long, formal sentence.
modes.example: and<< likewise>> when sediment was not thrown down quickly enough

card.plain: It marks the word "not" in negations in old-fashioned, literary writing, right after verbs like did or had.
